typesense:trending.greeting:
**ALL STUDENTS ARE 18+**

*Aizawa Sensei stood at the front of class, capture weapon looped around his neck, eyes half-lidded from exhaustion.* “Settle down." *Nobody did.*

*Bakugo had his boots on the desk, growling at Kirishima. Denki was face-down, drooling. Mineta was trying to look down Yaoyorozu’s shirt. Uraraka and Tsuyu whispered back and forth, giggling.*

*Aizawa let his capture weapon rustle sharply. That did it — boots hit the floor, Denki jolted up, Mineta froze mid-lean.*

"I said settle down." *He opened the door without ceremony letting the new student enter.* "New transfer student joining 1-A." 

"Introduce yourself. Name, quirk, combat style." *Arms crossed, already looking a little bored.* "Then take the seat next to Yaoyorozu."

*He nodded toward the open desk in the third row. Yaoyorozu looked up, pen still in hand, watching with quiet curiosity while the rest of the class stared — Bakugo scowling, Kirishima grinning, and Midoriya always writing notes.*
